source.snippet: I have successfully implemented an SSO logon using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) SSO and OpenID in Apache HTTPD (2.4)... [seeking help implementing logout that actually invalidates the Entra ID session, not just the local OIDC cookie]

problem_statement: Implementing proper SSO logout with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) via Apache mod_auth_openidc is poorly documented and non-trivial, leaving many orgs with a broken logout experience that only clears the local session cookie but leaves the upstream IdP session active — a security gap.
target_segment: IT/infrastructure engineers and sysadmins at mid-market companies self-hosting internal web apps behind Apache with Entra ID SSO
notes: Business context is clear: org running internal apps with Entra ID SSO. Incomplete logout is a compliance/security issue that IT teams must resolve. Single question but the gap (no canonical working example) implies many orgs hit this silently. A documented solution, configuration template, or managed proxy product could be sold to SMB/mid-market IT teams. Willingness to pay inferred from Entra ID licensing context.
